sentences.en: Little did I imagine he would achieve a perfect game.
sentences.zh: 我根本没想到他会打出完美比赛。

sentences.en: You cannot achieve the impossible without attempting the absurd.
sentences.zh: 不尝试荒谬的事情就无法实现不可能的目标。

sentences.en: Nothing great has been achieved by playing it safe.
sentences.zh: 没有什么伟大的成就是一成不变就能达成的。

senses.zh: 达到预期的目的；实现预期的结果；如愿以偿
